result.description:
We have an exciting opportunity for an IT Operations Engineer to join our National Operations Centre (NOC) team. We are seeking candidates with a strong background in IT systems and networks, coupled with extensive experience in managing IT service desk operations, and providing high-level support to internal and external staff. In this role, you will play a pivotal part in collaborating with various IT teams, ensuring the delivery of high-quality services to the business, while striving for operational excellence.

Please note this will be a permanent, full-time role based out of our Sydney CBD Office. It will involve participation in a continuous shift roster - working 4 days on and 4 days off. The shift patterns will be made up of 2-day shifts from 7am-7pm and 2-night shifts from 7pm-7am. 

Some of your responsibilities will include and are not limited to
•	Monitoring critical business services and systems, networks and infrastructure
•	Provide after-hours service desk support to users
•	Identify and address issues before they affect business operations
•	Handle and administer privileged accounts securely

What you’ll have done
•	Seasoned service desk analyst, NOC or equivalent experience (minimum 2 years), ideally in a continuous shift operations centre (24/7x365)
•	Strong technical knowledge of networking protocols such as TCP/IP, SNMP, DNS, DHCP, and other networking protocols
•	Strong problem-solving skills to identify and resolve issues quickly, including experience with major incidents
•	Familiarity with server operating systems (e.g., Windows, Linux) and basic server administration
•	Experience with technology service monitoring tools - systems, application, and networks such as Centreon, Solarwinds, PTRG desirable
•	Familiarity with IT service management tools and frameworks (ITIL v3/4)
•	Demonstrated experience in delivering exemplary support, customer service and training
•	Excellent documentation skills for keeping records of issues, resolutions, and operational procedures
•	Effective communication with the ability to work as part of a team, especially in a high-pressure environment where collaboration is essential to solving issues

What we can offer you
•	5 weeks annual leave 
•	Annual salary between 90,000 - 95,000
•	Opportunities to progress within I-MED’s continued growth and expansion 
•	Being part of a team that makes a difference to the functioning of our ever-growing business 
•	Experience in communicating with different areas of IT 
•	Enjoy exclusive benefits including discounted private health insurance, salary packaging, Fitness Passport access, lifestyle and travel discounts, I-MED services for your family and employee wellbeing support.

About Us
At I-MED, we're more than just a medical imaging provider - we're a community of passionate professionals committed to excellence for our patients. With over 200 clinics and a staggering 6 million patient procedures annually, we proudly stand as one of the largest providers of medical imaging in the world. Our success lies in our people with over 350 dedicated doctors and 4,000 staff members who actively share clinical knowledge and expertise. 

If you're looking for the next step in your career and are passionate about the delivery of excellence within healthcare services, apply today!

Join a high-performing engineering team delivering complex, cutting-edge defence programmes   
  Brisbane | 12-Month Contract | Highly Attractive Daily Rates  
   
 An exciting opportunity exists for an experienced Senior Project Engineer to join a leading global defence organisation supporting a significant land systems program. Working within a multidisciplinary engineering environment, you will play a key role in the delivery of complex capability projects from concept through to production and integration.   This is an excellent opportunity for an engineer who enjoys balancing technical design responsibilities with project delivery, stakeholder engagement, and engineering governance. 
       
  Your new role  
   
 As a Senior Project Engineer, you will be responsible for supporting the planning, coordination and delivery of engineering activities across a complex defence program. You will work closely with design, systems, manufacturing and project management teams to ensure technical outcomes are delivered on time, within budget and to the required standards. 
   
 A key part of this role will involve the development and management of engineering designs and documentation using Creo or CAD and associated product lifecycle management tools.     Key Responsibilities  
   
 
 Coordinate engineering activities across the project lifecycle. 
 Support project planning, scheduling and technical risk management. 
 Develop and review mechanical designs, assemblies and engineering documentation. 
 Create and maintain 3D CAD models and technical drawings using Creo or CAD. 
 Manage engineering change processes and design modifications. 
 Liaise with internal and external stakeholders to ensure project objectives are achieved. 
 Support design reviews, verification and validation activities. 
 Ensure compliance with defence, quality and engineering standards. 
 Collaborate with manufacturing and production teams to support successful delivery outcomes. 
 
   
   
  What you'll need to succeed  
   
 
 Degree qualified in Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics Engineering or a related discipline. 
 Demonstrated experience working as a Project Engineer within defence, aerospace, heavy vehicle, manufacturing or other complex engineering environments. 
 Strong mechanical design experience. 
 Strong experience using PTC Creo or CAD for 3D modelling and design activities. 
 Experience producing and managing engineering drawings, BOMs and technical documentation. 
 Exposure to PLM systems such as Windchill would be highly regarded. 
 Strong stakeholder engagement and communication skills. 
 Ability to work within multidisciplinary engineering teams and manage competing priorities. 
 
   
  What you'll get in return  
   
 
 Long-term contract opportunity with strong likelihood of extension 
 Highly competitive daily rates 
 Opportunity to work on a nationally significant defence capability program. 
 Brisbane (Eagle Farm) location with a flexible and collaborative team environment. 
 Exposure to advanced engineering and cutting-edge defence technologies. 
 
  *Australian Citizenship is mandatory*   
  What you need to do now  
   
 If you're interested in this role, click 'apply now' to forward an up-to-date copy of your CV to  lauryn.reddick@hays.com.au  
   
 If this job isn't quite right for you, but you are looking for a new position, please contact us for a confidential discussion about your career. 
    Please  click here  to apply.

Heavy Truck Drivers (ANZSCO: 733111)

Full-time/Permanent

$80,000 - $90,000 (salary will be considered commensurate to qualifications and experience)

The company wishes to employ heavy truck drivers to work with our mining and Long Line Haul (East-West and North-West) clients

Duties and Responsibilities:

*Drive truck with capacity of more than 3 tons to transport and deliver cargo or materials.
*Work in remote locations and drive long distances.
*Deliver goods via heavy haulage trucks, sometimes over interstate routes or spanning several states.
*Conduct daily pre- and post-trip inspections of vehicles to maintain working operations, record any defects they find.
*Load and unload cargo with multiple drops.
*Secure proof of deliveries and return relevant paperwork to office timely.
*Ensure load restraint is performed as per heavy vehicle load restraint guide. 
*Maintain radio or telephone contact with base or supervisor to receive instructions or be dispatched to new location.
*Be efficient in completing the necessary delivery paperwork including run sheets and work diaries.
*Be able to take orders for new deliveries. 
*Maintain truck log according to State and Federal regulations.
*Report to a dispatcher any incidents encountered on the road.
*Follow accident procedures if an accident occurs.
*Fill up on fuel, clean truck, and wash windows on completion of each trip.
*Keep record of materials and products transported.
*Keep a log of activities.
*Keep truck, and associated equipment, clean and in good working order.
*Plan routes using maps or satellite tracking.

Qualifications and Experience:
*AQF certificate II or III
*Valid Australian MC truck licence
*Minimum of 1 year’s recent heavy/multi-combination driving experience
*Able to work with, maintain and carry out general repairs and maintenance on pumps, metres and related equipment
*Demonstrate sound geographic knowledge Australia-wide
*Be highly reliable with a first-class approach to safety and customer service with good communication skills
*Fatigue Management Certificate
*Able to pass a drug and alcohol and pre-employment medical
*MSIC Card
*Load restraint certificate
*Require DG Licence or willing to obtain
*Dogs and chain experience
*Side and End Tipper experience 
*BFM certificate is required or willing to obtain

Maintenance Planner (ANZSCO: 312911 – Maintenance Planner)

Full time/Permanent

$80,000 - $ 90,000 (salary will be considered commensurate to qualifications and experience)

Duties and Responsibilities:

*Compile and maintain an online system of all vehicles and related equipment (e.g. lifting equipment, cranes for lifting and loading onto trailers, hand-held equipment, manual transport equipment, ramps, straps, winches, chains and pulleys, etc) within the business
*Prepare preventive maintenance plans (the “plans”) that are aligned with the organization’s maintenance goals
*Generate work orders and create maintenance schedules to ensure the availability of resources to carry out relevant maintenance as per the plans
*Maintain sufficient inventory of parts needed to perform any planned and/or unplanned maintenance
*Inspect all facilities and equipment on a regular basis to prioritize needed maintenance before it becomes a problem
*Estimate costs of labour and parts
*Budget for and schedule any maintenance that must be performed on a regular basis and in cases of emergencies
*Serve as a liaison between maintenance personnel and vehicle operatives
*Maintain records and files essential to maintenance management
*Source, negotiate and develop service agreements with external maintenance providers
*Coordinate between maintenance providers, vehicle operatives and stakeholders involved in the provision of maintenance works

Media Account Service Roles
Trading under Publicis Media Australia
Location: Sydney or Melbourne or Brisbane

Senior Account Executive (Also known as Senior Planning Executive, Senior Client Executive)

The purpose of the Senior Planning Executive role is to autonomously plan and implement client campaigns -they are ultimately responsible for the delivery of all client activity. They will help lead the delivery of communication plans and management of digital campaigns from buying and implementation through to reporting and the delivery of holistic campaign learnings.  The Senior Planning Executive is to work in collaboration with the wider team to deliver integrated and creative plans that considers all vehicles (display, SEM, SEO, Social) and mainstream media at every possible opportunity. The Senior Planning Executive ensures attention to detail in all facets of their work and will take responsibility for any errors that occur.  Experience required: Minimum 3-4 years’ experience understanding and working knowledge of Australian Media Landscape and digital marketing advertising. Preferably a University degree or higher education qualifications. Expert understanding and working knowledge of Australian medialandscape. Expert across the following Office platforms: Word, PowerPoint and Excel. Have an understanding and experience using the following tools: eTAM, BMD, Roy Morgan, EMMA, eRAM, Nielsen Digital / Answers, Sizmek and/or DCM, MOVE, AQX Fusion 

Salary:$80 –90k package

Account Manager (Also known as Client Manager, Planning Manager, Associate Account Manager, Associate Client Manager, Associate Planning Manager)
The purpose of the Account Manager role is to create media strategy and implementation recommendations across all media for clients and oversee the delivery of all campaigns.  This role requires skills in creativity, media planning, media marketplace, tools and market dynamics. The Account Manager is also responsible for directly managing any Co-ordinators and Planning Executives within the client team and supporting the senior client leads in managing the client relationship through regular communication, presentations, WIP’s, and financial process.  Experience Required:  3-4 years’ industry experience. Expert across the following Office platforms: Word, PowerPoint and Excel. Possess sound financial management skills. Strong media understanding including an understanding and experience in using the full suite of media planning and measurement tools.
Salary: $80k-$100k package

Associate Account Director (Also known as Associate Client Director, Associate Planning Director, Senior Account Manager, Senior Planning Manager, Senior Client Manager)

This role is focused around communications planning, account service and leading a team of direct and indirect reports. For this role, we require someone who is comfortable in establishing and owning senior level client relationships and helping drive the client forward in regards to their media/marketing plans. This role also offers you the opportunity to test and learn new things allowing you to be at the forefront of new learning. The purpose of the Associate Account Director is to ensure that client service is of an exceptionally high standard. The Associate Account Director works closely with the Account Director and/or Business Director and/or Group Business Director to ensure that the product delivered to clients is best in class and in line with the agency’s values.  Experience required: 4-5 years industry experience, people management skills, strong written and verbal communication skills , client Leadership ,excellent presentation skills, sound business acumen ,strong understanding of media channels, understanding of media systems.
Salary: $90k-$110k package 

Account Director (Also known as Client Director, Planning Director)
The purpose of the Account Director is to lead the development of media strategy and communication plans across their client portfolio. They are ultimately responsible for their teams work & output. They must ensure attention to detail in all facets of their teams work and take responsibility for any errors that occur. It is expected that they will participate in, embrace and lead training forums for their team and where applicable the common good of the agency. The Account Director is also responsible for developing long-term, mutually beneficial relationships with all clients - they should look to own the Marketing Manager level client relationship, and in some instances at the Marketing Director level. Account Directors will be called on to assist or lead New Business opportunities
Salary: $100k - $130k package

Business Director (Also known as Client Partner)
This role is focused on driving client business relationship and deliver best in class business and communications solutions for clients.  The Business Director role includes: ultimate responsibility in overseeing and managing accounts, manage client expectations, anticipate client needs, resolve issues, identify client business requirements and work with team and cross functional teams to deliver the right solutions. Proactively source and present media / group solutions to help grow your client’s business 
Experience Required:  8-10 years industry experience at the minimum, people management skills, strong written and verbal communication skills , client leadership ,excellent presentation skills, sound business acumen, strong understanding of media channels understanding of media systems.
Salary – over threshold 

Group Business Director (Also known as Client Partner)
Purpose of the role is to inspire and manage the client team and specialists to deliver world class work, service and partnerships. Deliver services and products that drives marketing led growth for our clients. Develop trusted and positive senior client relationships e.g. CMO, Marketing Director and ensure the agency team is acting as a true marketing partner. Develop internal and external client action plans that: Drives you and your team to deliver against client needs in a style which makes your client consider you their most valued business partner.  Identify opportunities to deliver marketing led growth via our diversified service. Custodian of the whole client contract, scope of work and have a plan in place to safeguard any upcoming renewals/negotiations (with General Manager/Managing Director).  Experience Required:  12-15 years industry experience, people management skills, strong written and verbal communication skills , client leadership, excellent presentation skills, sound business acumen, strong understanding of media channels, understanding of media systems.
Salary – over threshold 


All of the above roles require a relevant tertiary qualification or a minimum of 5 years of relevant experience in lieu of qualification.

Roles could also be available in Sydney, Melbourne, Brisbane
